ogTitle: Where to Stay in Nimmanhaemin, Chiang Mai
ogDesc: The best hotels in Nimmanhaemin by budget.
intro: Nimmanhaemin (locals just call it "Nimman") is Chiang Mai's densest cluster of cafés, restaurants, and design shops. The main Nimmanhaemin Road and its numbered sois branch off into endless coffee shops and small independent stores, while the MAYA mall sits on the corner and One Nimman across the way is an event square lined with shops. The real draw is being able to explore the whole area on foot without relying on a car, plus easy access to Chiang Mai University and Doi Suthep. Stays here suit café-lovers who want a base they can walk out of and reach everything.

blocks.html: Short answer: Nimmanhaemin is Chiang Mai's most popular café and lifestyle district, right next to Chiang Mai University, with the MAYA mall and One Nimman within walking distance of cafés, restaurants, and design shops across the area. Stays range from hostels and budget hotels around ฿1,200 up to design and 5-star properties around ฿3,000–3,500. It suits travellers who want to explore on foot without taking taxis everywhere.

items.name: Travelodge Nimman
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Value · families · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A large hotel with plenty of rooms right on Nimmanhaemin Road, an easy walk to cafés and the mall, with a pool and gym. Reviews praise the clean, newish rooms and the breakfast. A budget pick in a modern building with a strong location — good for families or longer stays who want low rates without roughing it.

items.name: Stay With Nimman
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Rooftop pool with mountain views · value · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On Nimmanhaemin Road, a few steps from One Nimman. The highlight is a rooftop pool with mountain views and a glass window set into the pool wall. Rooms are big and clean, and reviews rate the service and breakfast well. A good fit for couples or anyone who wants a nice pool at a still-reasonable price.

items.name: Art Mai Gallery Nimman Hotel
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Art lovers · unusual design · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A boutique hotel where each floor was designed by a different Thai artist, with an art gallery on the ground level and rooms themed around different art movements. It has a pool and gym and sits in the heart of Nimman, within walking distance of cafés and MAYA. Reviews praise the location and breakfast. Good for travellers who want a stay with real character.

items.name: Moose Hotel Nimman
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Next to One Nimman · cosy feel · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: Right beside One Nimman and about a 5-minute walk to MAYA, decorated with a warm moose theme. Rooms are spacious with big beds and feel clean, and reviews single out the breakfast that mixes Western and Northern Thai dishes plus attentive staff. A comfortable mid-range pick in a central spot where everything is close on foot.

items.name: G Nimman Chiang Mai
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Photo lovers · adults only · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An all-white minimalist design hotel that is adults-only, with just a handful of rooms so it stays quiet and private. The standout is a photogenic pool set in the centre of the building. It's at the southern end of Nimman near Chiang Mai University, and reviews score it very highly for service. Ideal for couples who want a good-looking, calm, child-free stay.

items.name: AMANOR Hotel Chiang Mai
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: All-suite · rooftop bar · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An all-suite boutique hotel (formerly akyra Manor) close to Nimmanhaemin Road, with spacious suites that have a sofa and an outdoor spa bath on the balcony. The highlights are the Rise rooftop bar and pool, plus an Italian restaurant, Italics. Reviews praise the location and staff. A great choice for big rooms and a place to drink in the city view.

items.name: U Nimman Chiang Mai
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: 5-star · rooftop infinity pool · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 5-star hotel on Nimmanhaemin Road blending modern style with Lanna touches, with a rooftop infinity pool and bar, an all-day restaurant, and a wine bar with a library. Its central location is walkable to malls and cafés, and reviews praise the warm service and cleanliness. A fit for travellers who want a full-service hotel in one of Nimman's best spots.

faq.a: It suits café-lovers, walkers, and anyone who wants a base where everything is close — malls, restaurants, and design shops are all within walking distance. The area is lively with food available day and night, so it works well for couples, groups of friends, and remote workers. If you want somewhere quiet or close to the Old City temples, you may prefer a different area.

faq.q: Is it easy to reach the Old City and the airport from Nimman?
faq.a: Yes. Nimman sits just west of the moat, so a songthaew (red truck) or Grab to Tha Phae Gate in the Old City takes about 10–15 minutes. Chiang Mai Airport is very close too, around a 10–15 minute drive. That's a real plus of the area — it's near the food, the sights, and the airport all at once.

It depends where you stay. The main Nimmanhaemin Road and the area around One Nimman are busy with shops and people, and there can be some noise from evening into the night. For quiet, pick a hotel deeper in a soi or a room that doesn't face the street. Many properties here are new buildings with good sound insulation — reading recent reviews about noise before booking is the surest check.
